dedupe_keys.name: list of slovenian amateur radio repeaters zrs

description: The repeater database of the Amateur Radio Association of Slovenia lists Slovenian voice repeaters in printable tables for the 6 metre, 2 metre and 70 centimetre bands, D-STAR repeaters and EchoLink gateways. Each entry gives the input and output frequencies, the channel and call sign, the site (for example Mrzlica, Pohorje, Ljubljana, Lisca) with its Maidenhead locator and height above sea level, notes on CTCSS tones, digital modes such as DMR and C4FM and links to networks, and the owner and system operator. The list can be printed or saved. Access is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the list is maintained by volunteers and does not give dates of last change for each entry, and it describes amateur, not public safety networks. Coverage is Slovenia. It supports emergency communications planning and resilience studies of radio links that work when public telecom networks fail, such as during floods; related records are the HRVHF Croatian repeater list, the HA2TO Hungarian repeater list and the Greek amateur voice repeater table.
